div.div:
Notation (Crow's Foot)
PK primary key FK foreign key UK unique
underlined = primary-key column
NULL = nullable column (blank = NOT NULL)
type → table = FK whose line is not drawn here
Dashed table = reference stub (detailed on another page)
Line ends
┤├ exactly one o┤ zero or one
o< zero or many ┤< one or many
Composite / multi-column UNIQUE constraints, CHECK
constraints and append-only triggers are listed in
docs/database/DATABASE_DESIGN.md.

div.div:
inventory_movements rules (CHECK constraints)
• resulting_stock = previous_stock + quantity_change; both ≥ 0; quantity_change ≠ 0.
• Sign by type: SALE, ADJUSTMENT_OUT < 0; all other types > 0.
• Exactly the reference FK matching the type is set (receipt / order / return); OPENING_STOCK and adjustments have none.
• adjustment_reason required iff type is ADJUSTMENT_IN/OUT; reason OTHER requires notes.
• UNIQUE (order_id, product_id, type), (purchase_receipt_id, product_id), (sales_return_id, product_id) give DB-level exactly-once stock effects.
• inventory_movements and audit_logs reject UPDATE/DELETE (trigger).
